mechanism: Retrieval of retrospections built from MBPP problems to guide iterative code refinement on HumanEval
evidence_scope: the model retrieves and leverages similar problems from its MBPP experiences, effectively boosting its performance.
evidence_role: This work presents Past as a Guide (PaG), a simple approach for Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve the coding capabilities by integrating the past history with interactive and iterative code refinements.
